title: Kiritani Haruka — Donuts And Memories〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Welcome back, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Welcome back♪
Did you get the limited time yakisoba bun?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did. I'm glad I went to go get it as soon as class finished.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know it's supposed to be different from the usual, but in what way exactly?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The noodles they've put in the bun are different. This time they're stir-fried with beef and a specially made sweet and spicy sauce.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really?
Oh, you've bought two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looked really good and I have a feeling I'll gobble it up in seconds...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, who wouldn't want to eat lots of their favorite food♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, good point.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Now that I think about it, I feel like we had a similar conversation back when we first started eating lunch together...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well then, shall we have lunch?

rows.Speaker: Saki, Haruka & Ichika
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That limited time yakisoba bun was really good. I do like the usual one a lot as well, but I think having something different once in a while makes me appreciate it all the more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha. Once you like something, Ichi, you reeeally don't get sick of it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I suppose that's true...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. But never getting sick of eating the same thing is something I sort of wish I could do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, take my lunches for example. They don't change all that much, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you do always have chicken and broccoli in them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can change up the dressing or use different recipes each time, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do get tired of having the same thing. Sometimes I want a variety.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I'm a little jealous that you can eat the same thing every day with no problems, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, the reason I can keep eating yakisoba buns is simply because I like them, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Favorite foods, huh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You like sweets, right, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. But unless it's an important celebration or my cheat day, I try not to eat them often.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I had a feeling...
Trying not to eat the things you like seems really hard...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
And on that note, I have great news for you, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great news?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, the cafe I work at has come up with a new menu♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Get this! My manager knows a certified nutritionist and worked together with them to make a healthy, balanced lunch menu and dessert!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Your cafe really did that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! This all happened because we did a survey not too long ago and noticed that more people are looking to take care of their health.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The lunch menu is pretty heavy and the dessert has quite a bit of volume, but overall it's actually not that many calories! The customers love it too♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds nice. But I don't think I'll be able to try out the lunch menu since I have school on weekdays and work on weekends...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but the dessert isn't limited to lunch, so you can order it whenever!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? In that case, I might be able to open my schedule enough to try it after school sometime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Let's free up a day when we can all go together♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Neither can I.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm so happy I became friends with Saki and Ichika...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If it's them, even when I go back to the credit-based course...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm going to treasure the friendships I've made in the general education course.)
